system.description:
Jungle/island guerrilla tradition, hit and vanish.

  • Vanishing Shot: Once per encounter, after making a ranged attack while moving, become hidden (see Disengage & Hide in The Arneyan Codex) until the start of your next turn, if any cover or foliage is within reach.
  • Island Craft: Advantage on Fletcher's Craft checks using improvised/natural materials rather than proper tools.
